name: Bun cha ca
summary: Bún chả cá is fish-cake noodle soup, sold from the noodle boats at Cái Răng. Pull alongside one during the market and order a bowl.
howToEat: On the noodle boat during the market.
seoTitle: Bun cha ca at Cai Rang
seoDescription: Fish-cake noodle soup from a noodle boat at the Cái Răng floating market.
